title: Planet Tweaks V3.1.2 NOVA TITAN - Debloat Apps Suite, Jump-Shoot Zero Lockout Studio, Diego & Niki Viral Themes, Zero Mojibake
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.1.2 NOVA TITAN: (1) Dedicated Debloat Apps Sidebar Tab: One-click background worker thread and telemetry stripping for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Discord, Spotify, Razer, and Logitech. (2) Jump-Shoot Mouse Fix & Diagnostic Studio: Zeroes Accidental Activation Prevention (AAPThreshold = 0) and PalmCheck lockouts to eliminate missed shotgun shots and delayed clicks while jumping (Spacebar) or moving (WASD). (3) Tab Leaking Race Condition Eliminated: Sequence-guarded async renders ensure fast tab switching never leaks cards across categories. (4) Diego & Niki Viral Palettes: Expanded Theme Suite with Solar Coral, Forest Violet, Kinetic Tangerine, Royal Health Purple, OLED Pitch Black, and Nova Matrix. (5) Strict Zero-Mojibake Mandate: 100% clean UTF-8 emojis and zero corrupted character encoding across all UI views and docs.
